clue.text: Cloud cover is right in position

indicators.note: in tells us the single letter for right is set within the word for position

parts.note: one's status is one's position or standing

explanation.surface: A remark that the overcast sky is exactly where it should be.
explanation.walkthrough: R goes inside STATUS. Stratus is a flat grey sheet of low cloud, so 'Cloud cover' is a fair definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Stratus is a uniform layer of low cloud that blankets the whole sky, a kind of cloud cover.

clue.text: Begs to put off retirement?

definitions.meaning: a dog that begs rears up on its hind legs
to delay going to bed, staying awake late

explanation.definitionFit: A dog begs by rising on its haunches, and someone who stays awake rather than retiring to bed does the same.

clue.text: They're made by those who deliver ammunition

definitions.text: They're made by those who deliver
definitions.meaning: a postman or milkman makes daily delivery circuits

explanation.definitionFit: Delivery workers do circuits of their routes, and single shots of ammunition are counted the same way.

clue.text: A celebrant seen around a place of worship

indicators.note: around suggests the letters are moved about into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A priest is spotted near a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' looks like 'near', but it scrambles A CELEBRANT.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabernacle is a building or tent used for religious services, such as a chapel or meeting house.

clue.text: Is able in a way, but limited

indicators.note: in places the word for being able inside the abbreviation for way

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
can means is able

explanation.surface: Someone is capable in a fashion but only up to a point.
explanation.definitionFit: Scant means barely sufficient, in short supply, so restricted in amount.

clue.text: Let everybody marry with love at heart

indicators.note: at heart puts the letter for love in the middle, between the two words it joins

parts.note: all means everybody
to wed is to marry
O is love, a zero score in tennis

explanation.surface: A plea to let everyone marry, provided love is at the centre of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Let and the past participle of permit are interchangeable: being let in means being permitted in.

clue.text: Troops appearing twice in a Daily Telegraph — initially it makes a change

parts.note: men are troops, soldiers

indicators.note: in places the second batch of soldiers between the newspaper's initials
initially takes the first letters of the paper's two-word name

parts.note: the soldiers appear twice, so men again

explanation.surface: Soldiers show up twice in this newspaper, which makes a difference.
explanation.walkthrough: 'appearing twice' means MEN is used twice: once after A and once between D and T.
explanation.definitionFit: An amendment is an alteration, typically to a text or law, so it is a change.

clue.text: Departed after time

definitions.meaning: dead, as in the departed or the deceased
behind schedule, after the expected hour

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both deceased, as in one's lamented husband, and arriving after the due hour.

clue.text: The fighters' craft

parts.note: not skill in combat but the vessels used for fighting at sea

explanation.surface: A phrase about the skill of combatants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'craft' looks like skill; it means vessels, those built for naval war.
explanation.definitionFit: Warships are naval vessels designed for battle, craft used by fighting forces.

clue.text: Drops from one's hand

parts.note: a card player throws away unwanted cards from the hand held

explanation.surface: Someone lets something slip from their fingers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hand' looks like the body part; it is the set of cards held in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games a player throws out unwanted cards, letting them go from the hand dealt.

clue.text: It's quite rough and ready, as a rule

definitions.text: It's quite rough and ready, as a rule

parts.words: It's quite rough and ready, as a rule
parts.note: a rough-and-ready guide is a rule of ___, named after measuring by a digit's width

explanation.surface: A description of something approximate that serves as a guideline.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase 'rule of ...' completes with this word: a rule of thumb is a rough practical guide. 'as a rule' looks like 'usually' but points to the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A rule of thumb is a rough-and-ready practical principle rather than a precise measure, so the digit names the rough rule.

clue.text: Openings for super rate of exchange

indicators.note: exchange suggests the letters are swapped around into a new order

explanation.surface: A financial remark about openings created by a favourable exchange rate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rate of exchange' looks like one finance phrase, but 'of exchange' is the anagram signal working on SUPER RATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Apertures are holes or gaps, that is, openings through which light or air passes.

clue.text: One taking part in an emergency

definitions.text: One taking part in an emergency

parts.words: One taking part in an emergency
parts.note: a stand-in actor takes over the part only when the regular player cannot go on

explanation.surface: A description of someone who joins in during a crisis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking part' sounds like joining in, but here it means taking on an acting role.
explanation.definitionFit: An understudy learns a role so as to step in and play the part if the lead actor falls ill.

clue.text: Stop article by TV doctor

indicators.note: this word only joins the neighbouring pieces: it says which one stands next to which in the answer

parts.note: Doctor Who is the long-running BBC television science-fiction hero
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An instruction to halt a piece of writing by a television physician.
explanation.definitionFit: The command used to halt a horse is an exclamation meaning stop.

clue.text: It makes sound sense to those in need

definitions.text: It makes sound sense to those in need

parts.words: It makes sound sense to those in need
parts.note: a device that makes sounds audible to the hard of hearing

explanation.surface: Something that is perfectly reasonable for the needy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound sense' looks like good judgment; it is the sense of hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: This device amplifies noise for people with impaired hearing, giving them the sense of sound.

clue.text: Inevitable comment on hopeless case

definitions.meaning: unavoidable, something that has to happen
what someone says with a shrug about a situation nobody can fix

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes something unavoidable, and it is the resigned remark made about a lost cause.

clue.text: Presumably it shouldn't have the lion's share of the bed

definitions.text: Presumably it shouldn't have the lion's share of the bed

parts.words: Presumably it shouldn't have the lion's share of the bed
parts.note: a flower named after a big cat, in a flower bed, jokingly told not to hog it

explanation.surface: A joke about a big cat that ought not to take up most of the bed.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'bed' is a flower bed; the striped big cat in the flower's name would hardly want a lion's share.
explanation.definitionFit: The tiger lily is an orange spotted garden flower grown in beds, named after the big cat.

clue.text: Geoff sat out in the wings

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: An actor called Geoff sat waiting in the wings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges GEOFF SAT. The wings are the hidden side areas of a stage.
explanation.definitionFit: The wings of a theatre are the areas beside the stage hidden from the audience, so out of view.

clue.text: There's no duty here and no charge for wine

parts.note: free means costing nothing
port is a fortified wine from Portugal

explanation.surface: A duty-free place where wine costs nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A free port is a harbour zone where goods may be landed without paying customs duty.

clue.text: Matches to be made if three girls go wild

indicators.note: going wild suggests the letters run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: Matches will be struck if three girls run riot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go wild' works on IF THREE GIRLS, twelve letters in all.
explanation.definitionFit: Firelighters are things used to kindle fires, which matches also do, so both serve as fire starters.

clue.text: Guess what the poet Donne was by profession

definitions.text: what the poet Donne was by profession
definitions.meaning: John Donne was a clergyman, Dean of St Paul's

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to guess by insight, and as a noun it means a clergyman, which Donne was.

clue.text: Verbal critical reports of shows

indicators.note: verbal means spoken, so the word is said rather than written

parts.note: reviews are critics' reports

explanation.surface: Spoken critiques of theatrical performances.
explanation.definitionFit: Revues are theatrical shows of sketches, songs and dances.

clue.text: Appear to observe many

parts.note: to observe is to see
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, hence many

explanation.surface: A note that one can seem to watch a great number.
explanation.definitionFit: To seem is to give the impression of being something, which is to appear.

clue.text: Boat train being derailed

indicators.note: derailed suggests letters knocked off their track into disorder

explanation.surface: A boat train is coming off the rails.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boat train' reads as one railway term, but 'Boat' is the definition and 'derailed' scrambles TRAIN BEING.
explanation.definitionFit: A brigantine is a two-masted sailing vessel, a type of boat.

clue.text: Gosh! Southern European birds!

parts.note: gee is an exclamation of surprise like gosh

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise at birds from southern Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Geese are large waterfowl, so they are birds.

clue.text: British isle shortly to join a state of America?

parts.note: IOW is the abbreviation for the Isle of Wight, an island off England's south coast

explanation.surface: A British island briefly joins an American state.
explanation.definitionFit: Iowa is one of the fifty United States, in the Midwest.

clue.text: Make a sorry speech?

parts.note: a speech saying sorry rather than a poor-quality speech

explanation.surface: A question about giving a feeble talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sorry speech' suggests a dreadful talk; the real sense is a speech of regret.
explanation.definitionFit: To say sorry for something is to express regret, giving a formal statement of contrition.

clue.text: Breathe one's last during a university farewell

indicators.note: during places the dying inside the letters that follow it

parts.note: to breathe one's last is to die

explanation.surface: Someone expires while at college, saying goodbye.
explanation.definitionFit: This French word is used in English as a solemn goodbye.

clue.text: Mouthful of water

parts.note: not a gulp but the broad tidal mouth of a river

explanation.surface: A gulp of water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mouthful' suggests a drink, but it is a mouth full of water: where a river meets the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: An estuary is the wide tidal mouth of a river, a mouth literally full of water.

clue.text: Objects about the French not finishing

definitions.note: an adjectival phrase meaning never coming to a close

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for objects goes round the French article

parts.note: ends are aims or objects, as in ends and means
les is French for the (plural)

explanation.surface: Someone objects at length about the French not completing things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Objects' looks like a verb of protest; it is the noun meaning aims.
explanation.definitionFit: Something without conclusion goes on forever, never reaching its close.
